comment: The owner's answers on which species are native around a place, where the herbarium evidence alone cannot settle it (F220, V3.12). One entry per species, keyed by the catalogue's scientific name: {"ruling": "native" (yes) or "not_native" (no), "on": the date}. No reasons: the owner answers yes or no where confident and leaves the rest, and pages say only that a species was confirmed on review. An answer overrides the derived tier in data/local_flora.json and survives every re-derivation; it cannot make a species native that VASCAN does not record native in the province. The answers come from the review page (tools/local_flora_review/README.md): python scripts/derive_local_flora.py --merge <its rows or its export>
